pins.title: Why Teams Keep Revisiting the Same Decisions
pins.text: Repeated decisions can signal missing rationale, unclear ownership or unreliable records. Explore the Knowledge Governance Diagnostic workbook for investigating one specific breakdown.
pins.alt_text: The Context Engine graphic showing a notebook and pen. Text reads: “Why Are We Revisiting This Decision? A practical knowledge governance diagnostic.” Button reads: “Run the diagnostic.”

pins.title: How to Identify a Knowledge Handoff Problem
pins.text: Information can exist in a team without reaching the person who needs it. The Knowledge Governance Diagnostic helps structure an investigation into one context or handoff failure.
pins.alt_text: The Context Engine graphic with three map markers connected by a dashed path. Text reads: “Where Does Important Context Get Lost? Map one breakdown before choosing a fix.” Button reads: “Explore the diagnostic.”
